title: A worker leased a checkout of the fleet repository writes bin/queue.py findings into that checkout's own queue/ (heater_hook.REPO resolves to the worktree), and dispatch close releases the worktree, so the finding is lost: happened to 46e285e1bfd0's finding 6e2302faa051. queue.py should write to the canonical fleet repo regardless of which checkout it runs from. tools/queue.py
